reports.title: Meha Carneiro: Prevention of future deaths report

promises.quote: A profile of when children and young people attend the ED over a 1-year period has been obtained to ensure that RNCs are rostered on at peak times.
promises.summary: Roster children's nurses based on attendance patterns.

promises.quote: A new band 7 supervisory Nurse in Charge (NIC) role has been implemented within ED to ensure there is now visible senior support available 24 hours a day for the entire department.
promises.summary: Implement 24/7 senior nursing support in ED.

promises.quote: Continuous collaborative working between ED and the division of Women and Children to develop a rotation pathway for RNC's is planned to be in place by October 2024.
promises.summary: Develop rotation pathway for RNC staffing.

promises.quote: The ED children's area rota is produced by the band 7 lead nurse a minimum of 6 weeks in advance.
promises.summary: Produce ED children's rota 6 weeks ahead.

promises.quote: A minimum set of core competencies that adult nurses must have completed prior to caring for a child or young person has been agreed as follows: a. Minimum of 18 months post registration experience b. Completion of Paediatric intermediate life support training c. Completion of the internal 2 day paediatric study days d. Completion of paediatric sepsis e-learning package e. Following completion of the above, an additional day shadowing a trained Registered Children's Nurse will be completed.
promises.summary: Require adult nurses to complete paediatric training before caring for children.

promises.quote: Children and Young People (GYP) escalation tool has been reviewed to ensure there is clear guidance on escalation triggers and the actions required.
promises.summary: Review and update escalation tool for child deterioration.
